title: Final Temperature Estimate
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide a final estimate for the sun's surface temperature T_S.

title: Glass House Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must explain why the temperature inside a glass house is greater than T_0.

title: Equilibrium Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive or reference the equilibrium condition relating solar and terrestrial radiation.

title: Use of Stefan-Boltzmann Law
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Stefan-Boltzmann law to both the sun and the earth.

title: Parameter Values
description: Optional Criteria: The student should substitute reasonable values for all parameters in their calculations.

title: Temperature Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the formula for the temperature T in the glass house.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in their equations, particularly in the equilibrium condition.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.
